title: Parse numbers from digit codes
prompt: The input is a list whose elements are decimal digits 0..9 or the separator -1 (no other values appear). Every maximal run of consecutive digits spells one non-negative decimal number, most significant digit first (leading zeros are allowed and ignored, so 0, 0, 7 spells 7). Return the numbers in the order they appear. Separators at the start or end, or several separators in a row, produce no numbers; the empty list gives the empty list.
